title: Checkpoint: relocation walk
prompt: The hardest Q4 variant: minimum moves from (row, col) to the cell holding `target`, moving up/left/right/down, or -1 if unreachable. A BFS or a repeated-scan distance fill both work — small grids. This fuses navigation, guards, and a sentinel.

tests.name: moves minimized
tests.hint: BFS with a distance grid, or relax repeatedly: dist[r][c] = min neighbor dist + 1.
